lemma inferred_irrational {α κ : ℝ} (hκ : 2 ≤ κ)
    (hinf : {x : ℚ | |α - x| < 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ}.Infinite) : Irrational α := by
  apply (Real.infinite_rat_abs_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq_iff_irrational α).mp

  intro x hx
  change |α - (x : ℝ)| < 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ at hx

  refine hx.trans_le ?_
  apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
  rw [← Real.rpow_natCast]
  exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by exact_mod_cast x.den_pos) hκ
lemma generalize
    (hR : ∀ {α : ℝ}, Irrational α → IsAlgebraic ℚ α → ∀ {κ : ℝ},
      {x : ℚ | |α - x| < 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ}.Infinite → κ ≤ 2)
    {α : ℝ} (halg : IsAlgebraic ℚ α) {κ : ℝ}
    (hinf : {x : ℚ | |α - x| < 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ}.Infinite) : κ ≤ 2 := by
  by_contra! hκ
  exact (hR (inferred_irrational hκ.le hinf) halg hinf).not_gt hκ
lemma recover
    (hR : ∀ {α : ℝ}, IsAlgebraic ℚ α → ∀ {κ : ℝ},
      {x : ℚ | |α - x| < 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ}.Infinite → κ ≤ 2)
    {α : ℝ} (_hα : Irrational α) (halg : IsAlgebraic ℚ α) {κ : ℝ}
    (hinf : {x : ℚ | |α - x| < 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ}.Infinite) : κ ≤ 2 :=
  hR halg hinf
lemma finite_iff_bound (α : ℝ) :
    (∀ {κ : ℝ}, {x : ℚ | |α - x| < 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ}.Infinite → κ ≤ 2) ↔
      ∀ κ : ℝ, 2 < κ → {x : ℚ | |α - x| < 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ}.Finite := by
  constructor
  · intro h κ hκ
    exact Set.not_infinite.mp fun hinf ↦ (h hinf).not_gt hκ
  · intro h κ hinf
    exact le_of_not_gt fun hκ ↦ hinf (h κ hκ)
example {α κ : ℝ} (_hα : Irrational α) (_halg : IsAlgebraic ℚ α)

  fail_if_success

  fail_if_success

#check_failure Roth.approxSet

namespace Roth289Modern
open Filter
open scoped Filter
lemma cofinite_iff_finite (α κ : ℝ) :
    (∀ᶠ x : ℚ in cofinite, 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ ≤ |α - x|) ↔
      {x : ℚ | |α - x| < 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ}.Finite := by
  simp only [eventually_cofinite, not_le]
lemma exponent_iff_cofinite (α : ℝ) :
    (∀ {κ : ℝ}, {x : ℚ | |α - x| < 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ}.Infinite → κ ≤ 2) ↔
      ∀ κ : ℝ, 2 < κ → ∀ᶠ x : ℚ in cofinite, 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ ≤ |α - x| := by
  constructor
  · intro h κ hκ
    exact (cofinite_iff_finite α κ).mpr (Set.not_infinite.mp fun hinf ↦ (h hinf).not_gt hκ)
  · intro h κ hinf
    exact le_of_not_gt fun hκ ↦ hinf ((cofinite_iff_finite α κ).mp (h κ hκ))
lemma cofinite_consequence
    (hR : ∀ {α : ℝ}, IsAlgebraic ℚ α → ∀ {κ : ℝ},
      {x : ℚ | |α - x| < 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ}.Infinite → κ ≤ 2)
    {α κ₁ κ₂ : ℝ} (halg : IsAlgebraic ℚ α) (h₁ : 2 < κ₁) (h₂ : 2 < κ₂) :
    ∀ᶠ x : ℚ in cofinite,
      1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ₁ ≤ |α - x| ∧ 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ₂ ≤ |α - x| :=
  ((exponent_iff_cofinite α).mp (hR halg) κ₁ h₁).and
    ((exponent_iff_cofinite α).mp (hR halg) κ₂ h₂)
lemma recover
    (hR : ∀ {α : ℝ}, IsAlgebraic ℚ α → ∀ κ : ℝ, 2 < κ →
      ∀ᶠ x : ℚ in cofinite, 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ ≤ |α - x|)
    {α κ : ℝ} (_hα : Irrational α) (halg : IsAlgebraic ℚ α)
    (hinf : {x : ℚ | |α - x| < 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ}.Infinite) : κ ≤ 2 :=
  (exponent_iff_cofinite α).mpr (hR halg) hinf
#print axioms Roth289Modern.cofinite_iff_finite
#print axioms Roth289Modern.exponent_iff_cofinite
#print axioms Roth289Modern.cofinite_consequence
#print axioms Roth289Modern.recover
end Roth289Modern

lemma rational_finite (a : ℚ) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 2 ≤ κ) :
    {x : ℚ | |(a : ℝ) - x| < 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ}.Finite := by
  apply Set.not_infinite.mp
  intro hinf
  exact (inferred_irrational hκ hinf).ne_rat a rfl
lemma sharp {α : ℝ} (hα : Irrational α) :
    {x : ℚ | |α - x| < 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ (2 : ℝ)}.Infinite := by
  simpa only [Real.rpow_two] using Real.infinite_rat_abs_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq_of_irrational hα
lemma coefficient_le_one
    (hR : ∀ {α : ℝ}, IsAlgebraic ℚ α → ∀ {κ : ℝ},
      {x : ℚ | |α - x| < 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ}.Infinite → κ ≤ 2)
    {α κ C : ℝ} (halg : IsAlgebraic ℚ α) (hC : C ≤ 1)
    (hinf : {x : ℚ | |α - x| < C / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ}.Infinite) : κ ≤ 2 := by
  apply hR halg
  refine hinf.mono ?_
  intro x hx
  change |α - (x : ℝ)| < C / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ at hx
  change |α - (x : ℝ)| < 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ
  exact hx.trans_le (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hC (by positivity))
-- The pair representation has infinitely many exact unreduced representatives of zero.
def pairSet (α κ : ℝ) : Set (ℤ × ℕ) :=
  {hq | 0 < hq.2 ∧ |α - (hq.1 : ℝ) / hq.2| < 1 / (hq.2 : ℝ) ^ κ}
lemma zero_pairs_infinite (κ : ℝ) : (pairSet 0 κ).Infinite := by
  have hi : (Set.Ioi (0 : ℕ)).Infinite := Set.Ioi_infinite 0
  refine (hi.image (f := fun q : ℕ ↦ ((0 : ℤ), q)) (by
    intro a _ b _ hab
    exact congrArg Prod.snd hab)).mono ?_
  rintro _ ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  exact ⟨hq, by simpa using one_div_pos.mpr (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hq0 κ)⟩
example : ¬ (∀ {α : ℝ}, IsAlgebraic ℚ α → ∀ {κ : ℝ},
    (pairSet α κ).Infinite → κ ≤ 2) := by
  intro h
  have hh := h (isAlgebraic_zero : IsAlgebraic ℚ (0 : ℝ)) (zero_pairs_infinite 3)
  norm_num at hh
